events.title: Dreampair Desktop DEMO HOTFIX & Update (Oct 17)
events.summary: Hotfix Update News (Oct 17) System we've partially improved the issue of characters hiding behind other windows. Thank you for waiting! In General Settings, you can now turn on "Launch automatically after Steam login at startup" Focus Mode now has focus and break sounds Floor offset can now go up more The mouth stays still during thought bubbles Customization Improved the edges of bodies, faces and ears where other colors were mixing in Added an option to place the tail layer above the back hair

events.title: Dreampair desktop Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The Dreampair demo is out now! We've added a wide variety of face parts for this demo. We're planning to offer many more body options in the full version. There are 6 hidden items to find in the demo. We won't say how to unlock them, but we think you'll find them easily! If you enjoy the game, please tell your friends!
